acceptedAnswer.text: NullAI is an independent software lab that builds Zoth Studio, ZothOS Linux and related local-first AI tools. It is built in public by 1nc0gn30.
Zoth Studio (https://zoth.nullai.tech) is a local-first AI studio with 80 tools: 56 run in the browser/WebGPU and 24 are CLI tools. It also groups tools into 43 workstations.
ZothOS (https://zothos.nullai.tech) is a Debian-based Linux distribution from NullAI that ships the Zoth tools and 23 loopback daemons that listen only on localhost.
Yes. Zoth Studio, ZothOS and the tools are free. Tips are optional.
Source lives on GitHub under https://github.com/NullAITech and https://github.com/1nc0gn30. 79 of the 80 tools have public GitHub source repositories.

mainEntity.name: Does NullAI send my data anywhere?

acceptedAnswer.text: The tools are designed to run locally. The 23 daemons bind to loopback (127.0.0.1) only.
Email contact@nullai.tech or reach @1nc0gn30 on X (https://x.com/1nc0gn30).
